playStore.fullDescription:
Lissom is a library of written yoga courses: 120 lessons in five courses, with the interface and every lesson available in 14 languages.

• Hatha: 60 lessons in 10 modules – natural breathing, preparation, supported postures, controlled transitions and independent session planning.
• Ashtanga beginner foundations: 19 lessons in 5 modules, with standing adaptations, traditional Sun A/B maps, four standing fundamentals and closing rest. This is not the full Primary Series.
• Supported Yin: 12 lessons.
• Supported standing Vinyasa: 14 lessons, with an optional knees-down floor extension.
• Chair/office yoga: 15 lessons.

Every lesson has a learning goal, a practice task, a self-check, an easier path, when to stop and its teaching sources. Choose comfortable support, a chair or a rest position.

You can mark the lessons you have practised. These records are your own reports and stay on your device; they are not a posture grade and do not certify mastery. Lissom does not use the camera to score, correct or count your movements. Lessons are written; there is no demonstration video.

You can use Lissom as a guest. A shared Motion account is optional and available from age 13; below your country’s digital-consent age, a parent or guardian approves it first. You can delete the account in the app.

Lissom offers general wellness information. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. Pregnancy, injury and chronic conditions need individual advice.

FREE PART AND MEMBERSHIP
The first part of every course is free: 47 of the 120 lessons, for example the first 24 of the 60 Hatha lessons. A Lissom membership or Motion+, each monthly or yearly, unlocks the remaining lessons:
• Lissom membership: the remaining lessons of all five Lissom courses.
• Motion+ (Lissom, Gravita, JabLab, Ostinato, Choreia): Unlocks the paid lessons and practice available today in all five Motion apps. Camera coaching and unreleased lessons are not included.

Eligible new subscribers get a 14-day free trial; the Motion+ trial is offered once per Motion account. Before purchase, Google Play shows the price in your currency. You need a Motion account to subscribe. Monthly or yearly plans renew automatically for the same period at the displayed store price until canceled. Manage cancellation in your store account. Deleting your Motion account does not cancel a store subscription. You can restore purchases in the app.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://yulalab.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://yulalab.com/en/privacy/motion
